label: Matt 14:1
text: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

label: Matt 14:2
text: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

label: Matt 14:3
text: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

label: Matt 14:4
text: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

label: Matt 14:5
text: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

label: Matt 14:6
text: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

label: Matt 14:7
text: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

label: Matt 14:8
text: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

label: Matt 14:9
text: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

label: Matt 14:10
text: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

label: Matt 14:11
text: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.

label: Matt 14:12
text: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.

label: Matt 14:13
text: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

label: Matt 14:14
text: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.

label: Matt 14:15
text: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

label: Matt 14:16
text:
But Jesus said to them,
“They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

label: Matt 14:17
text: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

label: Matt 14:18
text:
He said,
“Bring them here to me.”

label: Matt 14:19
text: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

label: Matt 14:20
text: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

label: Matt 14:21
text: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

label: Matt 14:22
text: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

label: Matt 14:23
text: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

label: Matt 14:24
text: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

label: Matt 14:25
text: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

label: Matt 14:26
text: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

label: Matt 14:27
text:
But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying,
“Cheer up! It is I!

Don’t be afraid.”

label: Matt 14:28
text: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

label: Matt 14:29
text:
He said,
“Come!”
Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

label: Matt 14:30
text: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

label: Matt 14:31
text:
Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him,
“You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

label: Matt 14:32
text: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

label: Matt 14:33
text: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

label: Matt 14:34
text: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

label: Matt 14:35
text: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick;

label: Matt 14:36
text: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

label: Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus
statement: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus.

label: Herod Antipas held the office of tetrarch
statement: Herod (Antipas) held the office of tetrarch of Galilee and Perea at the time.

label: Herod said Jesus was John the Baptizer risen from the dead
statement: Herod said to his servants that Jesus was John the Baptizer risen from the dead, whose powers worked in him.

label: John bound in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife
statement: Herod had laid hold of John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

label: John told Herod it was not lawful to have her
statement: John said to Herod, 'It is not lawful for you to have her.'

label: Herod feared the multitude who counted John a prophet
statement: Herod wanted to put John to death but feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

label: Herod's birthday kept with a banquet
statement: Herod's birthday was kept with a banquet at which guests sat at table and a daughter danced before them.

label: The daughter of Herodias danced before the guests
statement: The daughter of Herodias danced among the guests at Herod's birthday banquet and pleased Herod.

label: Herod promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked
statement: Herod promised with an oath to give the dancing girl whatever she should ask.

label: The head of John requested and given on a platter
statement: The girl, prompted by her mother, asked for the head of John the Baptizer on a platter, and the head was brought on a platter.

label: John beheaded in the prison
statement: Herod sent and beheaded John in the prison.

label: John's disciples took the body and buried it
statement: John's disciples came, took the body and buried it, then went and told Jesus.

label: Jesus withdrew by boat to a deserted place
statement: When Jesus heard of John's death he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart, and the crowds followed on foot from the cities.

label: Five loaves and two fish
statement: The disciples had only five loaves and two fish with which to feed the crowd in the deserted place.

label: Twelve baskets (kophinoi) of leftovers taken up
statement: After the meal the disciples took up twelve baskets (kophinoi) full of broken pieces left over.

label: About five thousand men ate
statement: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

label: The boat distressed by waves in a contrary wind
statement: The boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

label: The fourth watch of the night
statement: Jesus came to the disciples in the fourth watch of the night, the last of the night's divisions.

label: Jesus walked on the sea
statement: Jesus came to the disciples, walking on the sea in the storm.

label: Peter walked on the water and began to sink
statement: Peter stepped down from the boat, walked on the water toward Jesus, and beginning to sink cried out to be saved.

label: They came to the land of Gennesaret
statement: When they had crossed over, they came to the land (plain) of Gennesaret on the shore of the Sea of Galilee.

label: The people begged to touch the fringe (kraspedon) of his garment
statement: The people of Gennesaret begged to touch the fringe (kraspedon, tzitzit) of Jesus' garment, and as many as touched it were made whole.
